values.note: 2026 and 2027: $18 non-electric, $24 electric, the same in peak and non-peak seasons; group sites $39.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258617/rates (Peak Season 2026-03-20 to 2026-11-29 and Non-Peak seasons: PeakNonelectric 18, PeakElectric 24, PeakGroupCamping 39; same for 2027), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/cuga/planyourvisit/wilderness-road-campground.htm ('No full hookups (no sewer or water at individual sites)'; 'Loops B & C: Electric sites') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258617 ('43 sites with 20-,30-, and 50-amp electric hook-ups are available in loops B and C'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 151 wooded sites (the facilities text says 150): non-electric loops A, D, E, F; 43 electric sites with asphalt pads in loops B and C; tent-only group loops G and O (no RVs). All back-in except one pull-through. Catalog max vehicle lengths mostly 32 ft, a few 36-50 ft. Expect unlevel sites.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258617 ('Wilderness Road Campground includes 151 wooded sites'; 'Most sites require backing in with the exception of one pull-through site'; notice 'Campers should be prepared for unlevel campsites') + recreation.gov campsite catalog (Max Vehicle Length 24-50 ft, 98 sites at 32 ft) + https://www.nps.gov/cuga/planyourvisit/wilderness-road-campground.htm (loop layout), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Comfort stations with flush toilets and hot showers; dump and fill station near the entrance station (dump for campground reservation holders only). Cumberland Outpost gift shop/camp store (firewood, drinks), seasonal. No Wi-Fi.

facilities.source: https://www.nps.gov/cuga/planyourvisit/wilderness-road-campground.htm ('access to restrooms with flush toilets and showers'; 'A dump station available near the campground entrance station. A fill station available'; 'Cumberland Outpost Camp Store at Wilderness Campground ... firewood, drinks') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258617 ('A dump station, for campground reservation holders only'; 'Please note there is NO Wi-Fi at the campground'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Open year-round; from mid-November to mid-March only loops B, C, D and comfort station #2 stay open.

season.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258617 ('The campground is open year-round with limited campsites, as well as the comfort station between loops C and D, open during the winter season (mid-November to mid-March)'; notice 'Loops B, C, D and comfort station #2 will remain open from mid-November through mid-March'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov (every family site in the catalog is reservable). Camping limited to 14 days within a rolling 30-day period. Check-in after 2 pm, check-out noon; on-site check-in not required. Group sites book up to 12 months ahead.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/258617 (rules maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days'; notices) + recreation.gov campsite catalog (all STANDARD sites reservable) + https://www.nps.gov/cuga/planyourvisit/wilderness-road-campground.htm (group sites 'Can be booked up to 12 months in advance'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $18-24 (2026-27), 50-amp electric at 43 sites, no water at sites, 151 sites, showers, potable water, year-round (now from rec.gov's statement, was calendar-derived), reservable on recreation.gov. Added no sewer, 50-ft max (one pull-through), flush toilets, dump, camp store, no Wi-Fi, 14-in-30 limit. Phone 606-248-2817 matches. Not stated: family-site booking window, fcfs.
